items.question: I clicked a suspicious link but nothing obvious happened. Do I wait to see if I am sure?
items.answer: No. Report when harm is reasonably possible. Tell your line and the departmental incident contact, and say what you clicked. Do not wait for proof.
items.source_note: Derived from departmental enquiry records (anonymised). Placeholder until the IT Security Unit supplies the real record.

items.question: Should I post the suspicious message in the team chat so others can check it?
items.answer: No. Keep the detail to the incident route. Wide sharing spreads the lure and any data in it. Your incident contact will say what others need to know.
items.source_note: Derived from departmental enquiry records (anonymised). Placeholder until the IT Security Unit supplies the real record.

items.question: May I delete the mail and reimage the PC before I call anyone, so the desk looks tidy?
items.answer: Do not destroy the timeline before the incident route has told you to. Report first. Preserve what the local procedure says to preserve.
